balls.text: gets outside leg and goes for a slog to the on side but ends up slicing it to Yuvraj at covers. Very fine over from Jerome.
A fine bouncer outside off, Pollard has a crack at it but can only bottom-edge it and the ball rolls to the keeper.
the yorker ends up as a low dipping full toss, Harbhajan swings but is beaten by the lack of pace on that slower one. And is hit on the back pad. He was outside leg at the point of impact
goes for the slower bouncer this time and Pollard is too early into the pull shot. The ball bounds off the body to the leg side
More fumbles. This time from Robin, who was rock solid so far. Pollard didn't connect with the yorker length delivery and it bounced just before Robin who fails to collect it
slower one outside off, lifted to long-off for a single. Taylor doesn't collect the throw from Jhunjhunwala and Pollard will get back on strike.

28 runs from the over! Whoa! What an over. Wicked fun if you are a neutral or a Mumbai fan. Full and straight, Harbhajan opens his stance, gets the front leg out of the away and lofts it over long-off. It lands full on the boundary ropes. Manish Pandey signals six.
Slice of life! Harbhajan slices the full delivery up and over point.
low full toss this time, drilled to long-on
Rubbish delivery. Overpitched delivery and Pollard blasts this to the long-off boundary. Just a short distance to the right of the fielder but he had no chance.

the slower bouncer outside off and Pollard waits. And waits. And then he drags it from outside off to wide midwicket. No ball called for the second bouncer of the over. It was about throat high. Not over his head.
Pullhardddd! The big man is laying into Pune. Again, he moves outside leg, Thomas fires it full and Pollard crash-lands it over long-on
the bouncer arrives and it flies over Pollard, who was moving outside leg stump. It went right over him; can't be a leg-side wide. Was it for the height? It wasn't too high as well.
Crash wallop. He clears the front foot and whacks this full delivery past the umpire. He almost decapitates Dharmasena
full and wide, swing and a miss.
drags this past square-leg to retain the strike
Full delivery. Whack. The ball settles into Manish's palms at long-on. Brad Hogg coos in the air: "Pandee takes in the candy"
gets outside leg, Taylor bangs in a bouncer and Symonds smashes it like a tennis shot and the ball rolls down to left of long-on
slips in the slower one, forced down to sweeper cover
Bang! Pollard garu clears the front foot and smashes the full delivery over long-off.
moves outside leg and whacks it to deep midwicket fielder
leans forward to defend this to the on side
supah! lovely quickish skidding leg break ala Afridi. Pollard is late on the cut and Robin collects and screams. Perhaps he got excited that he took it
from wide of the crease, short of length skidder, Pollard mistimes the pull to midwicket

What a tournament this Rahul Sharma is having. Splendido! He tosses this up, slows up the pace and perhaps that fooled the batsman. Suman went for the big hit and ended up slicing it in the air and long-off moves in to take an easy catch. Fine fiery knock it was.
moves outside leg and has a go at it. But missed it completely. Robin collects
leans forward to defend a length delivery to the off side and rotates the strike over to Suman
Where have been they hiding Suman all along? He leans forward and crashes a full toss over long-off
leans forward to tap this to the off side for a single
leans forward to drive to long-on
Whack! Short in length and Suman pulls it to the boundary. He is having quite a night here. That was imperiously done
Punched! Short of length outside off and Suman plays a lovely punchy drive to wide long-off boundary
full and outside off stump, the batsman has a big swing and a miss

oh lovely legbreak! He might not turn em big but gets it to do just about enough. It lands on the middle and off line and breaks away quickly and Pollard is comprehensively beaten. They go upstairs for the stumping Pollard just about got his back foot back to the ground
stays back to gently push this to point region
just outside off, taps to Taylor at short third man
stays back to clip it to square-leg for a single

Rahul gets just desserts! Rohit went for the slog sweep but this was turning away from the off stump line. And Rohit ended up top edging it towards deep mid-on where Pandey catches it on the rebound. It popped out and fell back in to his palms.
good delivery, skidding on quickly from the middle and off line to outside off; Rohit is beaten on the drive
tapped clear of point for a single
gets forward to mishit this to long-on
Wow! It wasn't all that short but Suman unfurls a powerful and stylish pull for a stunning six!
the bouncer outside off and the batsman can't connect with the pull
on a length, around the leg and middle line, Rohit edges the intended flick to point region
full and straight, mishit back to the bowler
just outside off stump, steered to right of backward point for a single
presses back to dab this away for a single
Suman tries the shot that did Tendulkar in. He moved outside leg and crashed this full delivery on the middle stump up and over Ryder at cover
forces this down towards deep midwicket region
leans forward to tap this to the off side

Shout for a stumping! Lovely delivery, it lured Rohit forward into a drive and it dipped and turned away from the waft. Robin collected and broke the stumps. Rohit's back foot had moved outside the crease but just about managed to drag it back in. Itsy bitsy teeny weeny bit in.
Tonked! he leans forward and swings the bat. The ball lands in the wide long-on stands. Easily done!
leans forward to drive through the off side
around the leg stump line, tapped to the off side
length delivery outside off, punched down to deep point
tries to hit this down the ground but ends up dragging it past square-leg
gets forward to drive down to long-on
Yuv  Raj! Rayudu rushes down the track for the big hit but ends up slicing it to long-off. Robin Uthappa gets across and ruffles a stone-faced Yuvraj's hair.
leans forward to loft this over covers for a single
floated full outside off, driven down to long-on
quicker this time and Ambati Rayudu was trying to pull it to the on side but edges it to his pad
slower, short in length, turns away from the off, dragged down to long-on
leans forward to work it through midwicket for a single

Again that penchant to cut and pull irrespective of the length. Rahul gets this to skid on from a length and Rayudu, in a rich vein of form, goes for the pull and ends up mistiming it through vacant mid-on, down to long-on fielder
on the leg and middle, Rohit on drives it to long-on
gets forward to defend it down the pitch
dips on Rohit who was leaning forward, thinking it was a full toss but Rahul got it to dip on him and Rohit jabbed it back down the track
leans forward to drive to covers
low dipping full toss on the pads, flicked away for a single
gets back to clip this to the leg side
full and dipping on Rohit who eases it to deep point
gets back to tap this to midwicket for a single
tossed up full, Rohit leans forward to take it on the full and drives to sweeper cover

It's Jessy's turn to fly after Robin. Tendulkar moved outside leg and went inside-out to left of short extra cover. Just one little thing stood in his way. Well, one solid big thing. Jesse Ryder flew to his left to hold on to a good catch. Tendulkar survived that lbw but is gone now
Dharmasena doesn't give that lbw! It lands full on a length on the middle and leg and just about straightened. Tendulkar missed the sweep. That looked close. Very close.
shuffles across to tap it wide of midwicket
stays back to push the quickish leg break to point
slower, full again, this time Rayudu eases it to long-off
Like Umar Akmal, Rayudu is hell bent on cutting even length deliveries and from the stumps. This time he makes contact and the backward point intercepts
Lovey topspinner! It skidded on straight outside off  from a length and Rayudu is beaten on the cut. Not the length for that shot
skids outside off stump, cut away to backward point
Moves outside leg and then shuffles right back; And sweeps the full ball from the middle stump line to the fine-leg boundary
backs away a touch and cuts to sweeper cover
pushes this out to the off side
works this to deep backward square-leg for a single

Tendulkar's run out missed and Robin Uthappa goes down on to the ground in agony in pain on missing that out. It was dabbed very close to the leg side and Tendulkar caught the express train. Rayudu wasn't interested and he sent the little big man back. Robin dashed across, picked the ball, turned and fired the throw. misses! Tendulkar wasn't anywhere close to the stumps
fetches it from outside off and drags it through midwicket

Wristy upper cut ala Gundappa Vishwanath. Not the firm upper cut Tendulkar usually plays. This didn't climb all that much and he had to use his wrists and bottom-hand over time to slash it up and over slip. Beautifully done
steers this to third man for a single
leans forward to work it through to deep midwicket
on the pads and the ball rolls to fine-leg region
pushes it wide down the leg side and Robin shuffles across
There is a leg slip in place and the ball runs off the pad between the keeper and that leg slip. It was a full delivery on the pads, and Tendulkar misses out on the flick. Four leg byes, though
lands on a length around leg and moves towards middle, pushed to the on side for a single
slower one, around the leg and middle and it goes off the pads - Tendulkar tried to glance it - to the keeper
dabs this to wide mid--on region for a single
Another bouncer arrives, this one just outside off stump and Rayudu arches back, opens the bat-face and ramps it up and over slip! Not an upper cut; just a lovely steer
Taylor fires a bouncer and Rayudu top edges the pull to long-leg region; Wagh rushes towards his left, nearly gets there and throws in a dive but can't get to the ball in time
Rayudu backs away a touch and has a go at this outside-off delivery; no wood on leather
starts off with an outswinger and Rayudu steers it through covers
angling across Tendulkar who square drives to point

takes a step or two down the track and lunges out to steer it to backward point. It's deflected towards point. Jhunjhunwala has a shy at the striker's end and Tendulkar just about gets back. Overthrows, though
almost a yorker, on the middle, hint of inswing into Rayudu who stabs it off the inside edge to fine-leg region
digs this in short and Rayudu ducks
bending back from around the leg, and Tendulkar is hit on the pad
lands on a length on the middle and tilts back in slighly; Rayudu adjusts to jab it behind square-leg
gets behind the line of the length delivery on the off stump line and pushes it to the off
outside off stump line and Rayudu runs it to third man
shapes to defend a length delivery outside off but withdraws his bat at the last instant

Robin flies and pouches a good catch! It was a length delivery outside off stump, not much room there, and Blizzard tries to cut. The ball flies off the edge towards first slip almost but Robin Uthappa takes a step to his left and then dives with an outstretched left hand to take a stunner
short in length outside off, Blizzard opens the bat-face and runs it past the first slip and down to the third man boundary
gets forward to defend to the off side

Shout for lbw but there was some inside edge on it. Tendulkar shuffled across again, Wagh kept it full and straight on the middle and Tendulkar crouched to stab at it. The bat-and-pad took the ball to fine-leg boundary. Taufel signals boundary
similar delivery, Tendulkar taps it back to the bowler, on side of the pitch
on a length, moves towards middle, jabbed bat and pad back to the bowler
And Tendulkar whips it clear of that fielder. He shuffled across towards off and whip-flicked the full delivery from the off stump line up and through backward square-leg
Edged but short of third man. Hint of outswing on this full delivery and Blizzard goes for a lofted off drive and edges it to third man
full in length, outside off and he pushes it to covers
Sweet! It's a length delivery just outside off and Tendulkar caressed it on the up and through extra cover.

Ah! Tendulkar went back and across early - was he expecting a short ball?- the ball kicked up from back of length and straightened outside off. Tendulkar tried to adjust and pushed out at it but the ball  went past the edge
Thomas fires the bouncer and Tendulkar allows it to fly over his left  shoulder
doesn't quite get forward, just leans forward a touch at the crease and taps this to covers
full and in the corridor outside off stump and Tendulkar allows the ball to pass through to Robin
fullish, hint of inswing, on to the middle and leg line and Blizzard flicks it through backward square-leg.
Rahul Sharma, who bowled so wonderfully well earlier in the evening, gets a bouncer and he can't touch it. Mumbai win. Pune crash out to their seventh successive loss.
Wagh is run out. He bottom edged the drive to the keeper, wanted a run and couldn't get back in time to beat the throw from Rayudu garu
full toss but Robin misses out. He lifts it to left of long-on
works this full delivery to left of deep midwicket for couple of runs
leans forward to drive this to long-off
Sweet! Overpitched outside off stump and Robin plays an awesome shot. He just seemed to caress it and it has flown over extra cover.
A gem of a slower one. Loopy and dipping on a length and Mithun had no clue. He stabbed out at it and the ball lobbed to left of Malinga who rushed and lunged to pouch it.
another full toss, just a single this time; driven to long-off
low full toss and this time Robin forces it to long-off boundary. it lands full on the ropes.
loud cry for lbw but Dharmasena reckons it went off the bat.  And it did. No pad in fact. He shuffled to the off, trying to paddle scoop it and it went off the toe end of the bat to midwicket
Manish had to go for it. He went. He couldn't clear long-on though. Rohit times his jump and takes it.
low full toss, and even Robin has begun to play those iffy swats .. just a single
yet another one of his mistimes swat-drives. Too much bottom hand into the shot and the bat-face rotates at point of impact. The ball rolls to right of long-on
low full toss, whipped away to deep midwicket.
mistimes this one to the off for a single
Whack! The slog heave and even Pollard can't get the ball back in at the deep midwicket boundadry
full again, driven to long-off for a single
full and straight, just a single to long-on. 50 for Manish.
moves forward to ping long-on
And as you say that, he connects with one of them. A slower one, a  Big heave-ho and the ball flies over wide long-on.
the bouncer screams past Manish. Slow death here.
worked through the on side for a single
Another unconventional hit from Manish. Mishit again. The ball goes to long-on. Yet another one of those swats he plays
gets down the track for the big hit but had to reach out as Pollard pushed it outside off and he just about manages to push it to covers
gets forward to stab this full delivery and they rush across for the single
yorker on the middle stump line, dug out to the on side
full toss and Robin mishits it to long-on. He then reaches the other end and practices that shot again.
gets forward to loft this to right of long-on for couple of runs
very high bouncer. Wide.
yorker length on the middle and off, driven back to the bowler
low full toss on the middle, edged away to harbhajan at short fine-leg
fuller, straighter, driven to long-off
And here comes the slower one. Robin doesn't pick it and makes no contact with his slog. The ball winks past him and the off stump
Another bouncer, another pull attempted and again Robin is too late on it. Rayudu garu collects.
throat-high  bouncer and Manish plays his typical swat-pull to deep midwicket
fullish outside off, driven down to long-off. Game meandering along here
sprays to the leg side for a wide
fiery bouncer and Robin is late on the pull. Very late. The ball lobs gently towards unmanned mid-on
Finally he finds the gap. And gets the boundary. he moved outside leg and drags it to the cow corner
low full toss, driven to long-on
banged in short ,another swat-pull ... falls short of deep midwicket

dropped by Harbhajan He needs some lessons from Munaf I say. It was a length delivery tailing away from the batsman who top edges the lofted hit towards third man. Harbhajan rushed forward and made a desperate lunge but couldn't hold on
on the middle stump line, turned to midwicket
in the zone outside off, straightening as well, the batsman is beaten on the defensive push
the slow yorker on the middle, chipped uppishly but short of midwicket

What a ball. What a shot. What a catch! It was a nagging awkward lifter. Right at the body. No escape for Yuvraj who tried his best to twist his body and get out of the way. The body got out of the line of fire but the bat was held up like a periscope. The ball crashed into the bat and ricocheted to third man where Munaf Patel takes a tumbling catch. Yuvraj too tumbled and fell after he played that "shot"
Slice of audaciousness! He moved outside leg and carved the shortish delivery up and over backward point. It landed on the ropes. Well, the third ump reckons it landed just inside the ropes.
lifting delivery around off and middlel, Yuvraj decided very late to try help it up and over the keeper. He was in no position to play that shot and Rayudu collected the ball
fullish, whipped to Symonds at midwicket
around the off stump line, a length delivery, forced down to long-on
opens his stance and pulls the leg and middle line delivery between deep midwicket and deep square-leg
pulls this from around the off stump line to deep midwicket for a single
moves down the track, Harbhajan shortens the length, pushed to point
slower, fuller, on the leg and middle line, Yuvraj defends
UV rayed! Yuvraj jumps down the track and wallops this way way back into the long-off stands
on the pads, pulled away to deep backward square-leg fielder
Slugged! He fetched it from outside off stump and swung it across over square-leg boundary!
drags this short of length delivery to deep midwicket
around the off stump, steered to backward point
full and straight, from round the stumps, pushed back to the bowler
forces this down to long-on for a single
tries the short ball but slips it down the leg side and Manish pulls it to backward square-leg boundary. T
moves outside leg and goes for an ugly slog. No connection again. The ball flies over the stumps. Fine over.
beaten on the cut this time! He is yet to make a proper connection
stays at his crease and defends this to the off
in the zone outside off and Yuvraj is beaten on the drive

Shout for a catch Fierce bouncer and Yuvraj takes his eyes off the ball and just stabs at it. They appeal for a catch by the keeper. It hit his right shoulder. Did it brush the gloves before that? Not sure.

A catching chance for Tendulkar But he slips and falls at the last instant. Manish Pandey goes for a pull and ends up swatting it towards extra cover. Tendulkar rushed to his left and just as he was about to lunge forward his back foot got stuck into the ground and he tripped.
from wide of the crease, a length delivery, punched down to long-on
slower one around off and middle, pushed back to the bowler
Abhishek falls even as the required run rate climbs over 10. Abhishek went down the track, looking for the slog but top-edged it straight up. Rayudu jogged forward to take a simple catch
around that off stump, steered straight to backward point.
short in length, swatted down to long-on
moves in to the pads, tapped to midwicket
slower one on the middle, pushed down to long-on
nudges this wide of backward point for a single
gets down the track and punches the length delivery up and over mid-off. Neatly done!
swivels to pull the bouncer to deep midwicket region
around the off stump line, pushed out to the off
full and on the pads, turned to midwicket
length delivery outside off stump, mistimes the cut to point
around the off stump line, steered to backward point
on the middle stump line, worked to midwicket
gets forward to stab it to midwicket for a single
tries a slower one. Off-break action at the release. Manish picks it up, goes down on his knee and slog-sweeps it over midwicket boundary
on a length outside off, punched down to covers
low dipping full toss, pushed out to right of mid-on
full and well outside off, goes past the attempted square drive and Rayudu collects
Another bouncer, high this time and the ball flies over the batsman
good lifting delivery around off stump, Manish allows it to fly through to Rayudu
hops to defend this shortish delivery to the off side
hurls it wide down the leg side and the keeper dives to make a half-stop. Else four byes. Rather five wides
The previous delivery was a length ball; this one is short and lifting, Abhishek defends
run out of Manish missed by Symonds. It was tapped to the off and they think about a run. manish hares down before Abhishek sends him back. Symonds misses the throw at the non-striker's end
extra bounce on this short of length delivery, hits high on the bat and rolls away to the off
The bouncer this time around the leg stump line, the batsman ducks
leans forward to defend the full-length delivery

Dropped by Rohit at first slip. Tough chance unless you are Mark Waugh. Abhishek didn't quite into lean into his square drive and the ball flew over Rohit who leaped but could only get his finger tips to it
full in length on the middle, tapped towards mid-on for a single
leans forward to defend to point region
on the middle and leg line, from back of length, the batsman doesn't connect with the leg glance but it runs off the thigh pad to fine-leg boundary
Munaf fires in another bouncer and this flies through to the keeper

Another man down. Smith moves outside leg and Munaf hurls a bouncer and at the body. Smith was cramped for room and by the pace on it and ends up mistiming the pull shot. The ball lobs gently to midwicket
leans forward to mistime the drive to covers
skips down the track and flashes this length delivery wide of backward point. We have seen this so many times in international cricket from him.
short in length on the middle, pushed towards mid-on for a single
around the off stump line, eased towards long-on
slower, fuller, flicked to square-leg
topspinner outside off and Manish picks the variation off the pitch and pushes it back down the track
But Harbhajan drags this down the leg side and Manish pulls it to the backward square-leg boundary
turns from outside off, from over the wicket, Manish was surprised by the turn and bounce and he jabs at it it. The ball rolls off the handle
gets right back to turn the full delivery on leg and middle line to square-leg
leans forward to almost gently lift it up and over mid-off. Nonchalantly done. Hooper would have been impressed
kicks up from a length and straightens outside off, the batsman is beaten on a nervous prod
runs this down to the third man for a single
leans forward to drive to the off side where Suman makes a diving stop
in the zone outside off, Smith is beaten on the cut
short in length, at the body, tucked to square-leg
around the off stump line, defended to Symonds at silly point/cover. 0 for 1!
spins away from Smith who cuts to backward point
leans forward to tap this to the off side
beaten on the cut! It was a full length delivery outside off stump and bounced. Smith went for the cut and Rayudu doesn't take it cleanly
silly point and slip watch the new batsman defend
Ryder falls for a first-ball duck. It was floated full in length outside off and Ryder goes hard into an off drive. He only manages to slice a dolly to backward point.
